title: Invertibility of the realized direct-image coefficient exchange
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime and $K_0$ a field in which $\ell$ is invertible. Let $f:X\to Y$ be a separated finite-type $K_0$-morphism between finite-type $K_0$-schemes [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Let $E,L$ be finite extensions of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ and $\iota:E\to L$ a $\mathbf Q_\ell$-algebra embedding. For every integral constructible object $K$ on $X$ [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], the component at $K$ of coefficientExchange for systemDirect at $E,L$ and its actual systemDirectScalar mate [def-weil-system-operation-exchange-realization] is an isomorphism. This is the realized direct-image coefficient map, before rationalization; it makes no claim on arbitrary nonconstructible systems and has no Frobenius or compactification data.

source.place: Direct-image reduction paragraph and final coefficient-compatibility paragraph; the direct branch of modelScalarMap_isIso in def-weil-operation-exchange-coefficient-descent.

proof.text: Use the normalized direct-image/limit comparison at E and L [lem-weil-direct-image-limit-comparison]. Its inverse after the actual reduction/limit unit defines reconstruction from ordinary completed direct image to the system realization. The unit is invertible on integral constructible objects by [def-weil-system-operation-exchange-realization], so reconstruction is invertible on K and on its integral scalar extension, which is constructible by [lem-weil-integral-scalar-extension-constructible].

Finite freeness from [lem-weil-finite-free-completed-scalar-comparison] supplies the finite-product unit decomposition. Apply the already proved [lem-pur-finite-free-proper-scalar-comparison] to the actual ordinary completed scalar mate; this needs no properness of f. The two completion maps chi are invertible: K and its realized direct image are complete, the latter by directImage_constructible in [def-weil-system-operation-exchange-realization]. Convert intrinsic completeness to the unrestricted predicate using [lem-sf-derived-complete-legacy-comparison], choosing any auxiliary finite-field characteristic distinct from l.

The equality of actual morphisms [lem-weil-direct-image-scalar-realization-square] identifies scalar image of reconstruction, then chi, then the assigned coefficientExchange with ordinary scalar mate, direct image of chi, and reconstruction after scalar extension. Every factor on the right is invertible by Steps 1 and 2. Cancel the first two invertible factors on the left to prove IsIso of the assigned component. The cancellation and functorial preservation of isomorphisms are elementary categorical facts.

proof_origin.place: Finite-free ordinary scalar comparison plus the normalized reconstruction square; a compiling categorical reduction with two separate lower obligations. R8, 2026-10-27.

    (E L : Type u) [Field E] [Field L]
    [Algebra (Padic l) E] [Algebra (Padic l) L]
